transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I feel like… the part of me that used to want to connect with people, or enjoy things, has gotten really quiet. I still go through my responsibilities, but it’s more like I’m just moving from one obligation to the next.

I used to get something out of my work, yoga, going to galleries, even journaling. Lately those things don’t really pull me in the same way. That’s what finally made me think I should talk to someone.
Have you been feeling sad or down most days?
I don’t know that I’d call it sad, exactly. I haven’t noticed feeling down most days. It’s more like things feel muted, but not necessarily like I’m crying or depressed all the time.
Did these changes start after something stressful happened in your life?

Yes. It started around the time we took my older relative into our apartment. That was about eight months ago, and since then this change in how I’m thinking, working, and connecting with people has just kind of stayed.
Have you been feeling less interested in or able to enjoy things you usually care about?

Yes. That’s really the main thing. I still do the things I’m supposed to do, but I don’t feel much pull toward them anymore. Work, yoga, galleries, journaling… they used to mean something to me, and now it’s like I’m just moving through obligations. Even reaching out to people feels harder, like that part of me has gotten quiet.
If your older relative were no longer living with you, do you think this problem would mostly lift?

I’m not sure it would just lift. I mean, it did start when we took my older relative in, about eight months ago, but the change in how I’m thinking, working, and connecting with people has kind of stayed this whole time.
Before this started eight months ago, had you already been feeling this kind of low-interest, muted way for two years or longer?
No, not for two years. This has really been about eight months, since my older relative moved into our apartment. Before that, I wasn’t feeling this same muted or low-interest way.
Have you been feeling tired or low in energy a lot lately?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed being especially tired or low-energy in a clear way. It’s more that I’m just not very drawn to things, but I wouldn’t say I’m exhausted all the time.
Lately, have you been feeling hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d call it hopeless. I haven’t really noticed that specifically. It’s more like I’m just flat about things, but not thinking there’s no point or no future.
Has this change started to interfere with how well you function day to day?

Yes, a bit. I’m still going to work, but I’m not really functioning at my usual level. I’ve missed some grant deadlines, and my supervisor has quietly shifted some of my more demanding clients to other clinicians.
Before these past eight months, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt this same loss of interest or emotional flatness for at least two weeks?

No, not that I can remember. This past stretch is what stands out. It’s like the part of me that used to reach for people, enjoy my work, go to yoga or galleries, even journal… it’s just gone very quiet. I’m mostly just moving through obligations now.
During these past eight months, have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t think I’ve been feeling depressed exactly. I mean, not in the usual sad or crying kind of way. It’s more that I feel kind of muted or distant, but I wouldn’t really call it feeling down.
Have you had trouble sleeping lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a major sleep problem lately, at least nothing that stands out to me.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed concentration being a big issue. Maybe I’m a little less engaged sometimes, but I can still focus when I need to.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?
No, I haven’t really noticed any change in my appetite. It seems about the same as usual.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty lately?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been feeling worthless or overly guilty lately.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die or of harming yourself?
No, I haven’t had thoughts about wanting to die or harming myself.
Do you feel that caring for your older relative is the main reason you’ve been feeling this way?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed that caring for my older relative is the main reason, exactly. It may be part of things, but I can’t say that’s what’s driving it.
During these past eight months, have you been feeling slowed down in your body or movements?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed my body or movements being slowed down during that time.
Have you noticed any change in your weight lately, without trying to?
No, I haven’t really noticed any change in my weight. Not that I can tell, anyway.
Do you feel these changes are mainly a reaction to the stress of your older relative living with you?
I don’t really know. I can’t say it’s mainly because of my older relative living with me. It could add some stress, but I haven’t noticed it as the main reason.
